title.zh: Bill Pulte’s tweet cost FICO shareholders $4 billion
title.en: Bill Pulte’s tweet cost FICO shareholders $4 billion

current_state.zh: FHFA Director Bill Pulte announced that Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac will move to a single mortgage pricing grid incorporating VantageScore 4.0 alongside FICO's Classic score, ending FICO's de facto monopoly position and wiping about $4 billion from FICO's market capitalization.
current_state.en: FHFA Director Bill Pulte announced that Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac will move to a single mortgage pricing grid incorporating VantageScore 4.0 alongside FICO's Classic score, ending FICO's de facto monopoly position and wiping about $4 billion from FICO's market capitalization.
